tasks.label: Inspect 2023 case workbook
args: import zipfile,xml.etree.ElementTree as E; p=r'data/malaria_cases_akwa_ibom_2023.xlsx'; z=zipfile.ZipFile(p); n={'m':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}; ss=[]; root=E.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml')) if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist() else None; ss=[''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.findall('.//m:t',n)) for si in root.findall('m:si',n)] if root is not None else []; sh=E.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml')); print('SHEETS'); print(z.read('xl/workbook.xml').decode('utf-8')[:1500]); print('ROWS'); [(lambda cells: print(row.attrib.get('r','?')+'\t'+'\t'.join(((ss[int(c.find('m:v',n).text)] if c.attrib.get('t')=='s' else c.find('m:v',n).text) if c.find('m:v',n) is not None else ''.join(t.text or '' for t in c.findall('.//m:t',n))) for c in cells)))(row.findall('m:c',n)) for row in sh.findall('.//m:sheetData/m:row',n)]
